- Net45 exception: we can accept Net45 if Crestline agrees to a 1.5% price premium on the first 6 months of committed run-rate OR a 25% upfront activation invoice that counts toward the minimum commit. Either option preserves cash neutrality.
- Pricing slab smoothing: fine to move 40% / 60% split across tranche 1/2 instead of 50/50; please confirm concrete numbers so legal can update the appendix.

Mina — please send the PDF with redlines and a short summary of the option you want to propose to Crestline so I can sign off. Kimberly — if reverse-charge evidence is available, let's attach tax-evidence.xlsx and call out the required billing entity.
